title: SAIF-VERSE Update v1.1.3 — 24/7 Forceful Background Engine & Direct Native Dispatch
changelog:
🌸 What's New in v1.1.3:
• Dedicated native Android Foreground Service running forcefully 24/7 in background
• Holds persistent WakeLock so CPU never sleeps and tracking never halts
• Automatic background 10m movement detection even when app is minimized or phone locked
• Guaranteed native 1-hour stationary pulse dispatching directly to Discord from native Java
• START_STICKY auto-recovery: Android automatically restarts the service if killed
• Ground-truth location filtering eliminates all fake emulator coordinates
